Lemma
[Fundamental theorem for Lipschitz functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0435 1. apph:H.3\group Euclidean convexity If $f:[a,b]\to \R $ is Lipschitz, then \[ f(x)=f(a)+\int _a^x f'(s)\, ds \] for every $x\in [a,b]$, with the derivative defined almost everywhere.
